description: Use this when someone asks which robots MERA Robotics rents or sells, or about a model’s size, purpose or specifications. For rental with its own operators at events across Europe: Unitree G1 and Unitree H2. For sale: Unitree humanoids, quadrupeds, an industrial robot, a robotic hand, a VR teleoperation kit and inspected used G1 EDU, with type, purpose, key specifications and shop links. No prices: price and availability come from the shop or an inquiry. Where the host supports it, the result is shown as robot cards with an inquiry button.

availability.description: "rent" = robots available for rental with a MERA operator, "sale" = robots for purchase, "all" = both.

lang.description: Language of labels and descriptions: "pl" when the person writes in Polish, otherwise "en". Fact texts stay in their canonical Polish wording.

type.description: Optional: only robots of this type.
